A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the observed particle spectra in all these reactions are dominated by a single universal mechanism, the soft gluon breemstrahlung, and the observed particle densities are directly proportional to the corresponding colour factors.

The main takeaway from our work is that
soft particle production in e+e-, hadronic and nuclear collisions is dominated by coherent soft gluon bremasstrahlung.
the soft particle emission in hadronic and nuclear reactions, as well as in e+e- collisions, is governed by the same universal mechanism.

soft gluons, produced coherently in the initial stage of the collision, are a common ingredient of the soft hadronization in e+e, pp and nuclear collisions, and they can be described by the same QCD mechanism.
